answer.text:
According to Levi Strauss & Co.'s 2024 Form 10-K, the details for selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses for the fiscal year ended December 1, 2024, are as follows:

* **Selling, general and administrative expenses:** **$3,246.2 million**
* **Percentage of net revenues:** **51.1%**

### Breakdown of SG&A Expenses (Fiscal Year 2024):
* **Selling:** $1,411.4 million (22.2% of net revenues)
* **Advertising and promotion:** $453.4 million (7.1% of net revenues)
* **Distribution:** $400.2 million (6.3% of net revenues)
* **Other:** $981.2 million (15.4% of net revenues)
* **Total SG&A expenses:** **$3,246.2 million** (**51.1%** of net revenues)

*(Net revenues for fiscal year 2024 were $6,355.3 million: $\frac{\$3,246.2\text{ million}}{\$6,355.3\text{ million}} \approx 51.079\% \rightarrow 51.1\%$.)*

**Sources:**
* Accession: `0000094845-25-000005`, Section: `Filing Summary`, Chunk ID: `da80ad4b-2f94-5f0c-a589-c296c250a006`
* Accession: `0000094845-25-000005`, Section: `Filing Summary`, Chunk ID: `7800a9af-162a-5e50-b146-b4ba64b4b763`
